title: Minimum Moves to Balance Circular Array II
summary: People occupy a circular array of integer balances. A move transfers one unit to a neighboring person. Return the fewest moves that make all balances nonnegative, or -1 if impossible. This variant may contain multiple deficits; do not assume only one negative balance.
